description:
Search clinical trial registrations (ClinicalTrials.gov or WHO ICTRP) held in the NobleBlocks index.

        Each result carries its registry id (`trial_id`, e.g. NCT01234567). Use get_paper with that id
        for the full record.

limit.description: Number of results (1-50; your access tier may cap it lower).
limit.title: Limit

query.description: Condition, intervention, sponsor or title words.
query.title: Query

registry.description: clinicaltrials (ClinicalTrials.gov, default) or ictrp (WHO ICTRP registries).
registry.title: Registry

year_from.description: Only records published in or after this year.
year_from.title: Year From

year_to.description: Only records published in or before this year.
year_to.title: Year To

name: search_trials
title: Search clinical trials
